neighbourhoods.title: Neighbourhoods
neighbourhoods.description: StreetEasy-style neighbourhood slugs, e.g. williamsburg, east-village. Each is matched to Compass's location by trying <slug>-<borough>-ny (the borough input is tried first). A full Compass id like williamsburg-brooklyn-ny is used as is.

borough.title: Borough
borough.description: Used when no neighbourhoods are given (Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, Bronx, Staten Island); also tried first when matching neighbourhood slugs. Empty = all of NYC.

maxPrice.title: Max rent ($/month)
maxPrice.description: Only listings at or below this monthly rent (Compass's price.max filter).

minBeds.title: Min bedrooms
minBeds.description: Only listings with at least this many bedrooms (0 = studios included).

maxItems.title: Max rows
maxItems.description: Stop after this many dataset rows in total, split evenly across neighbourhoods. Coming-soon and exclusive listings are taken first.

maxPages.title: Max pages per neighbourhood
maxPages.description: Compass shows 41 listings per results page.

details.title: Detail pages
details.description: Detail pages add the agent, available date, listed date, no-fee and full photos (about 100 KB of proxy traffic each). Search cards alone have price, beds, baths, address, coordinates and the exclusive/coming-soon flags.

proxyCountry.title: Residential proxy country
proxyCountry.description: Two-letter country code for the residential proxy.
